2 · The difference

Jokić: 19 points, 13 rebounds, 8 assists

10 in the first quarter. Two assists shy of a triple-double.

3 · How it turned

Up 23 at the half, then held off a 37-point third

Jokić, Johnson and Murray combined for 53 of 114.

4 · Where it was won

Won it inside and on the glass

Points in the paint 54–44; rebounds 51–45. Denver turned it over just 3 times.

Nuggets 114, Pacers 102.

2 · The play of the game

Murray from 29.

Jamal Murray's 29-foot step-back three with 8:33 left that made it 102–90.
